   range of whole months.
5. If it returns a rejection, fix the problem it names and retry once.
   If the retry is rejected too, report the rejection instead.
6. Call `execute_query` with the SQL exactly as returned, last line included.
7. If a tool answers Forbidden, say which access is missing and that the
   data team grants it. Don't look for the number another way.
8. Report the result, the metric definition you used, the access line the
   result ends with, and the SQL.

       ROUND(SUM(premium_amt) - SUM(cancellation_amt), 2) AS net_written_premium
FROM analytics.fct_policy_premium AS f
JOIN analytics.dim_geography AS g ON f.geo_id = g.geo_id
WHERE f.status != 'quote' AND f.eff_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND f.eff_dt < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY g.region
ORDER BY g.region

content.text:
The data answers four of the six questions. The catalog has no loss ratio metric and no commission metric, so I couldn't answer questions 5 and 6. Every query below ran as you (signed in as analyst), with no row limits.

**1. Net written premium by region, Q3 2026 (July to September)**
Net written premium is premium written minus cancellations, counted in the month the policy takes effect. Quotes are left out.

| Region | Net written premium |
|---|---|
| APAC | 278,969.21 |
| EMEA | 343,269.84 |
| LATAM | 308,624.73 |
| North America | 312,420.42 |

**2. Gross written premium by product line, H1 2026 (January to June)**
Gross written premium is premium written before cancellations, without taxes and fees, counted in the month the policy takes effect.

| Product line | Gross written premium |
|---|---|
| Auto | 582,225.40 |
| Commercial | 1,453,678.56 |
| Home | 626,038.09 |

**3. Policies written, March 2026:** 95. This counts distinct policies with premium that took effect in March. Quotes aren't counted as policies.

**4. Paid on closed claims, Q2 2026 (April to June), by severity**
This is the amount paid on claims, counted in the month each claim closed.

| Severity | Claims paid |
|---|---|
| High | 18,616.26 |
| Low | 13,530.45 |
| Medium | 17,904.82 |

**5. Loss ratio by region, Q3 2026: can't answer.** The catalog has no loss ratio metric. I also can't build one from claims paid and premium, because claims paid can't be broken down by region. It only splits by severity and closing month.

**6. Agent commission, Q3 2026: can't answer.** The catalog has no commission metric.

The data team would need to add those two metrics before these questions can be answered.
